title: Document library
summary: Blood results, scan reports and letters, read once so the coach can use them.

requirements.text: A document is viewable the moment it is added; reading it happens in the background.
A document is read by the model when it is added, and again only on a retry or after an interrupted read; later the coach works from the text.

history.text: A document is read by the model once, at upload; later the coach works from the text.
history.reason: Version 1 said once; a retry or an interrupted read reads it again.

requirements.text: A document is one photo or a PDF; of a PDF the first `library.max-pdf-pages` pages are read, in order, and the original is kept.

history.text: A document can be a set of photos or a PDF, with its pages in order.
history.reason: Version 1 didn't match the product: a photo document has one page, and PDF reading stops at a cap.

requirements.text: A document is read automatically only by the device that added it.

history.text: A document is read only by the device that added it.
history.reason: A retry by hand runs on whichever device it is pressed on.
